map.输入质量、弹簧刚度、激励频率，计算系统固有频率、频率比、传递率与隔振效率: Enter the mass, spring stiffness and excitation frequency to compute the system's natural frequency, frequency ratio, transmissibility and isolation efficiency
map.💡 公式：固有频率 fn=(1/2π)√(k/m)；频率比 r=f/fn；传递率: 💡 Formula: natural frequency fn=(1/2π)√(k/m); frequency ratio r=f/fn; transmissibility T=√(1+(2ζr)²)/√((1-r²)²+(2ζr)²); isolation efficiency η=1-T
map.隔振有效区：频率比 r > √2（约1.414）时隔振效率为正，r 越大隔振越好: Effective isolation region: when the frequency ratio r > √2 (about 1.414) the isolation efficiency is positive, and the larger r the better the isolation
map.共振区：r 接近1时传递率急剧增大，应避免激励频率接近固有频率: Resonance region: when r approaches 1 the transmissibility rises sharply, so the excitation frequency should be kept away from the natural frequency
map.阻尼比 ζ 越大可降低共振峰值，但会降低高频隔振效果: A larger damping ratio ζ lowers the resonance peak but reduces the high-frequency isolation
map.常用隔振材料阻尼比：橡胶 0.05~0.15，金属弹簧 0.005~0.02: Typical damping ratios of isolation materials: rubber 0.05-0.15, metal spring 0.005-0.02
map.单自由度 fn=(1/2π)√(k/m) 估算振动固有频率。: For a single degree of freedom, estimate the natural frequency by fn=(1/2π)√(k/m).
map.由静变形 δ 反推 fn（δ=m·g/k）。: Back-calculate fn from the static deflection δ (δ=m·g/k).
map.若激振 30 Hz，fn≈15.9 Hz，频率比 r=30/15.9≈1.89>: If the excitation is 30 Hz, fn≈15.9 Hz and the frequency ratio r=30/15.9≈1.89>√2, in the isolation region with transmissibility <1, giving effective damping.
map.静变形和频率关系？: What is the relationship between static deflection and frequency?
map.δ=m·g/k，代入得 fn=(1/2π)√(g/δ)，只用测得的静挠度即可估固: δ=m·g/k; substituting gives fn=(1/2π)√(g/δ), so the natural frequency can be estimated from the measured static deflection alone.
map.频率比为何要 >√2？: Why must the frequency ratio be >√2?
map.当激振频率/固有频率 >√2 时传递率<1，系统起隔振作用；<√2 反而放大振动: When the excitation frequency / natural frequency >√2 the transmissibility is <1 and the system isolates; below √2 it amplifies the vibration instead.
map.振动隔振计算器，根据质量、弹簧刚度与激励频率，计算单自由度振动系统的固有频率、频: A vibration isolation calculator: from the mass, spring stiffness and excitation frequency it computes the natural frequency, frequency ratio, vibration transmissibility and isolation efficiency of a single-degree-of-freedom system, identifies the current operating region, and aids isolation design.
map.固有频率与频率比计算: Computes natural frequency and frequency ratio
